page: Microsoft Azure DC48eds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine built on an x86_64 Intel processor architecture and managed by Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 48 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 192.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio at 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance is configured without hardware graphics acceleration, operating with zero GPUs.

Integrated directly into the instance is 2832 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. In addition to bundled high-speed ephemeral NVMe disks, the configuration supports Premium Storage integration for expanded virtual disk operations. Network provisioning does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard virtual network routing or allocated IP configurations for external communication.

The 1:4 memory allocation alongside 2832 GB of direct-attached NVMe storage establishes strong resource density for input-output intensive workloads. By combining substantial memory capacity with high local read-write throughput, the architecture delivers operational efficiency for intermediate caching, large operational databases, enterprise enterprise resource planning backends, and data processing pipelines.
